text:
Rina: quick heads-up — brought up sparrow-lite-768 (float32) + int8-per-channel on staging. ran the short-query focused bucket (5k queries).
Ethan: sweet. any reg numbers yet?
Maya: initial paste from run_vs_float32.txt:
```
model                 recall@1  recall@5  recall@10  p95_latency_ms
sparrow-lite-768      0.605     0.790     0.848       18.9
sparrow-lite-768-int8 0.582     0.774     0.835       12.4  # ~3.3% recall@1 drop, latency + index memory win
index: nmslib (hnsw), M=16, ef_search=100, metric=cosine
```
Rina: interesting. drop concentrated in queries with very short prompts or acronym-only queries.
Ethan: did you use L2-normalization before indexing? that can help small-norm vectors.
Maya: yes normalized before indexing. I also tried whitening for one run (W=0.01 reg). silhouette rose slightly.
Rina: can you dump a few failure pairs? want qualitative check for obvious paraphrase misses.
Maya: posted top failure pairs to the run artifacts. examples: short prompt "XK-9" should map to product page but int8 matched a support ticket instead.
index-bot: noticed run label mismatch: run name missing ef_search tag; recommended format: model-quant-ef{val}-seed{n}.
Ethan: good catch. that explains earlier confusion when comparing runs. label them consistently.
Maya: reran with per-channel int8 + clamp=0.05 and ef_search=200. new numbers:
```
model                 recall@1  recall@5  avg_latency_ms
sparrow-lite-768-int8-perchannel 0.597  0.781     14.6
```
Maya: recall gap vs float32 now ~0.8% at recall@1 for short bucket. latency still ~+2.3x improvement vs float32.
Rina: nice. what's the memory footprint delta for the index and for model weights?
Maya: model size reduced ~3.1x (FP32->int8). index mem similar; ef_search increase bumped query CPU a bit but still well within SLO.
Ethan: two asks: 1) add a targeted short-query test set with acronyms/IDs and claim names, 2) add a small A/B in staging to route 10% short-queries to float32 for now.
Rina: agreed — also add a rule in Optimize to watch short-query recall@1. set regression threshold 0.02 absolute drop.
Maya: done. added run artifacts and updated onboarding doc draft with recommended quant: int8-per-channel + clamp=0.05 + ef_search=200 for production.
Rina: can we snapshot the UMAP before/after? curious about cluster topology for those acronym examples.
Maya: uploading UMAPs and kmeans silhouette numbers now. early look: silhouette improved slightly after whitening + clamp.
eval-bot: eval summary uploaded -> https://internal/redwood/runs/1752471111 (contains short-query failure pairs, UMAPs, per-cohort recall) :white_check_mark:
Ethan: thanks — once we confirm A/B doesn't show live regressions for 24h we can flip the default to int8-per-channel for this model.
Rina: leaving this thread open until A/B completes. closing checklist: update onboarding doc, create Optimize rule, run 24h A/B, ship config to dedicated staging.
Maya: note — CLI commands used:
```
# short-bucket smoke run
python -m eval.run_embed_smoke --model sparrow-lite-768 --quant float32 --index nmslib --ef_search 100 --seed 7 --out run_1752471111_fp32.json
python -m eval.run_embed_smoke --model sparrow-lite-768 --quant int8-per-channel --clamp 0.05 --index nmslib --ef_search 200 --seed 7 --out run_1752471111_int8pc.json
```
Rina: perfect. thanks everyone. we'll reconvene after the 24h A/B. :thumbsup:
